job.prompt:
Create a 2D industrial puzzle-platformer called Factory Lockdown.

I am trapped inside a dangerous automated factory.

The final security gate is locked. To escape, I must activate TWO separate switches located in different parts of the level.

The first switch activates moving platforms that let me cross a dangerous machinery pit.

The second switch disables a laser barrier.

The final gate should open ONLY after both switches have been activated.

Add patrolling robot guards and environmental hazards, but keep combat optional. I should be able to avoid enemies instead of fighting them.

Include industrial machinery, animated warning lights, moving parts, distinct environmental areas, and clear visual feedback whenever a switch changes something.

No collectible requirements. My objective is to solve the factory mechanisms and escape.
limitations: Approximation: switches enable moving alternate paths; the static main route remains traversable. Timed machinery represents the requested security barrier.
